description: This file defines the interface IBaseCodecProvider, which provides access to IBaseCodec implementations for different types within the Orleans.Serialization.Serializers namespace.

classes.name: IBaseCodecProvider
classes.description: An interface that provides access to IBaseCodec implementations for specific types.

methods.name: GetBaseCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a base codec for the specified type TField, where TField must be a class.
